First end unresolved. EO 9669 (Dec. 28, 1945; effective Jan. 1, 1946) transfers air-navigation facilities, property, operating functions and Budget-Director-determined funds in Iran from the War Department to the Administrator of Civil Aeronautics. EO 9709 (Mar. 29, 1946; 11 FR 3389) says in its paragraph 6 that its provisions apply to the facilities, property and functions transferred by EO 9669, which order is superseded, but its paragraph 5 makes its provisions effective for the facilities at each location only at the time or times agreed between the Department of Commerce and the War or Navy Department. The held sources give no agreement date, and no held source shows when the Director of the Bureau of the Budget made the fund determination in item (4) of EO 9669. So the date the supersession took effect, and whether EO 9669's commands were spent earlier on January 1, 1946, cannot be fixed from held evidence; the status ('no') is supported but the exact first-end date is only bounded between January 1, 1946 and the agreed per-location dates. Missing source: the Commerce-War/Navy agreements under EO 9709 paragraph 5, or a record of the Budget Director's determination under EO 9669.
